h1: Pattanipirom Boutique Hotel — An Arty Boutique with Its Own Coffee Roaster That Feels Like a Friend's Home
intro: If you're the kind of traveller who loves a small, design-led stay with good coffee in the morning, take a look at Pattanipirom Boutique Hotel · A 3-star boutique opened in 2023 in the Rusamilae area on Na Songkhro Road · The blue, loft-style building with black furniture is the work of an art-loving owner, so the whole place is filled with hand-picked décor and pictures · The standout feature is its in-house coffee roaster and bakery — wake up to fresh-roasted coffee and a croissant downstairs · Around 10 spacious, clean rooms with Smart TV/Netflix and halal breakfast · Rooms start from around ฿1,400/night

body.html: Pattanipirom is a tiny boutique that opened in 2023 in the Rusamilae area on Na Songkhro Road, the side of town near Prince of Songkla University · The first thing guests mention in reviews is the blue, loft-style building with black furniture that looks more like a design project than a typical hotel · The owner is into art, so the whole building is filled with hand-picked décor and pictures, giving it the feel of staying at a tasteful friend's home rather than checking into a hotel.

There are around 10 rooms, mostly Standard units with a king bed, and many guests note that the rooms are more spacious than expected, clean and nicely decorated · Each has a Smart TV with Netflix, a hair dryer and a full set of bathroom amenities · Beds are soft and the rooms are quiet, which suits couples or small families who want a calm stay without the bustle of a big hotel.

"Spacious, clean room with real style, and you wake up to fresh-roasted coffee and a croissant in the hotel's own cafe · The owner is friendly and clearly loves art — it feels more like staying at a friend's place than a hotel."

What really sets Pattanipirom apart from other stays in town is its in-house coffee roaster and bakery · Sitting down to fresh-roasted coffee and a ham-and-cheese croissant in a relaxed setting is something reviews bring up again and again · Breakfast is halal, which suits Muslim travellers · For coffee lovers and anyone who enjoys a cafe atmosphere, this is the main reason to book here.

The location is in Rusamilae, close to Prince of Songkla University, surrounded by cafes, convenience stores, a PTT petrol station and local food spots · It's about 300 metres from Pattani Provincial Stadium (Victoire Stadium) and around 900 metres from Somdet Phra Srinagarindra Park · The area is quieter than the old-town centre and easy to get around with a car or motorbike · Several reviews say it's especially convenient for motorbike riders, with parking and quick access to the main road.

To be honest, the limits here come from it being a very small hotel · With only around 10 rooms, it books up fast on weekends and holidays, so reserve ahead · Parking is available but limited, and some reviews note it's just outside the building nearby · Wi-Fi is focused on the common areas and cafe · There's no swimming pool or gym like a larger hotel · And because it's new, online review counts are still low — but the feedback that's there is almost all positive.

Overall, Pattanipirom is a standout pick for travellers who value design, atmosphere and good coffee over a full list of facilities · If your trip is about easy sightseeing, café-hopping, nice photos and a warm, homely place to come back to, it's a great fit in the Rusamilae area near Prince of Songkla University, in the ฿1,400–฿1,700/night range.

honestSummary: Pattanipirom Boutique Hotel is a small boutique that stands out for its design, atmosphere and in-house coffee roaster — spacious, clean, stylish rooms and an art-loving owner that make it feel like staying at a friend's home · The trade-off is a small property with few rooms, limited parking and no pool, but if you're a coffee lover who likes a design-led stay, it's a great fit in the Rusamilae area.

faq.q: Where is Pattanipirom Boutique Hotel and what's nearby?
faq.a: Pattanipirom is at 245/93-95 Moo 6, Na Songkhro Road, Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani · It's in the Rusamilae area near Prince of Songkla University · It's about 300 m from Pattani Provincial Stadium (Victoire Stadium) and around 900 m from Somdet Phra Srinagarindra Park · The old town and Lim Ko Niao Shrine are about 8 minutes by car.

faq.q: How much does Pattanipirom cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from around ฿1,400/night, mostly Standard rooms with a king bed · Types range from standard and window rooms up to Deluxe and Family rooms at about ฿1,650–฿1,900 · Prices vary by date and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Does Pattanipirom have a cafe and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes · the standout feature is its in-house coffee roaster and bakery · You can wake up to fresh-roasted coffee and a ham-and-cheese croissant downstairs · Breakfast is halal, which suits Muslim travellers.

It suits coffee lovers, travellers who like a design-led stay, and couples or small families who want a warm, homely vibe · It's a small boutique of around 10 rooms with loft-style décor and an art-loving owner · If you need a pool or lots of parking, consider a larger Rusamilae hotel like CS Pattani instead.

faq.q: Does Pattanipirom have parking and is it easy to get around?
faq.a: There is parking but space is limited, sometimes just outside the building nearby · Rusamilae has quick access to the main road and several reviews say it's convenient for motorbike riders, near a PTT station, cafes and convenience stores · It's easiest to get around with your own car or motorbike.
